Metadata.title: Pathshala — Learn in your language
Metadata.description: Courses, quizzes and live classes in Bangla and English. Find what you want to learn, and teach what you already know.

Home.title: Learn in your language, at your own pace.
Home.lede: Courses, quizzes and live classes in one place. Find the subject you want to learn, and teach what you already know.

Home.step2Body: Lessons, quizzes and notes together. Stop anywhere and pick up from the same place.
